fields.notes: SENT's protocol-level DFT surface is the per-frame CRC-4 nibble, the status nibble, the slow serial message, and the calibration/nibble range checks. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain sensor-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns; conformance is established by SAE J2716 compliance testing.
fields.ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

in_band_test_facilities.name: CRC-4 nibble
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-frame integrity check observable by the ECU.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Status nibble
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Status bits and slow-channel bit 2/3 observable each frame.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Slow serial message
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Sensor ID / diagnostic codes over many frames.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Slow serial message buffer (ID / data / CRC).
out_of_band_test_facilities: SAE J2716 SENT compliance / conformance testing.
Vendor sensor bring-up and characterization tooling (implementation-defined).
